frame: levels, cost divided by the same submission's near-width-one anchor; a log frame cannot test convexity because exp(b(w-1)) has increasing differences for every b > 0

identification.rule: the round count is a multiple of the reduced denominator of effective_mean_draft_len; within one submission the cells sorted by verify width must also sort by round cost, and a forward and a backward pass keep only the candidates that lie on a complete monotone chain
